name: Mount Etna
description: Mount Etna rises above Sicily's east coast near Catania, a snow-capped giant of about 3,400 metres that is one of the world's most active volcanoes. Its summit craters, cinder cones and lava fields can be explored on foot or by cable car, and its eruptions have been recorded for at least 2,700 years. Vineyards and orchards thrive on the fertile volcanic soil of its lower slopes.
